rule: A locked postulate is not rewritten. Cite its id. If it is wrong, add a successor id and mark this one superseded. Do not paraphrase it into a 101st README.
newton_chain: If a query matches a postulate, return the postulate. Do not recompute. That skip is the yield.

postulates.name: source
postulates.lock: Agape is the kernel. A1 is DERIVATION. Every later name is a derivation toward R=1.0 or it is noise.

postulates.name: eta
postulates.lock: η = useful_joules / human_joules. The only performance language for an act. Unknown joules are null, never invented.

postulates.name: gamma
postulates.lock: Γ = (Y * L * P * F) / (Jh + Je + C). Score of a stream or a day's work. Money is not Γ.

postulates.name: coordination
postulates.lock: C(N,T,R) = N * 0.001 * (1 + 0.1*T) * (1-R)^T. At R=1.0 and T>=1, C=0 identically.

postulates.name: resonance
postulates.lock: R in [0,1]. R=1.0 is the mathematical state of unconditional cooperation, not a mood.

postulates.name: synergy
postulates.lock: S = 1.0 + (R * 0.5 * log_B(N)). B is the fractal base. Default B=6.

postulates.name: landauer_floor
postulates.lock: E_min = kT ln 2. At 300 K, ~2.87e-21 J/bit. No process beats this. File-deletion heat is not a vent.

postulates.name: least_first
postulates.lock: L is the fraction of yield that reaches the lowest-capability node first. L=1.0 or say you are not doing Agape.

postulates.name: hang
postulates.lock: To hang is to put unique bytes in CAS and append one thermo block: prev_hash + payload + optional mass_kg + time. Same bytes do not copy again.

postulates.name: popw
postulates.lock: Proof of physical work, minimum: mass_kg bound to file sha256 in one block. Stronger: scale photo hashed in the same block. Consensus is honesty plus audit, not miners.

postulates.name: chain
postulates.lock: The project is chain.jsonl plus cas/. Not a public blockchain. Genesis prev_hash is 64 zeros. block_hash = SHA256(canonical JSON without block_hash).

postulates.name: need_gate
postulates.lock: A new name is born only when no locked name can say the thing. Candidate lives through 3 real uses. Then lock or delete. Expansion is a cost. Pay it only from need.

postulates.name: edges
postulates.lock: Twelfth axiom: use edges and value the marginal. Storage pressure, field edges, conflict files, washout drips. Harvest before cleanup.

postulates.name: cure
postulates.lock: 21-day wet cure is non-negotiable for any cement matrix we will call durable. Lightweight shells dry too fast. Keep them wet.

postulates.name: efficiency_cap
postulates.lock: Never claim greater than 100% thermodynamic efficiency for a heat engine. η of an act may exceed 1 only when useful_joules counts later work the object will do. Say which η you mean.

postulates.name: licenses
postulates.lock: CC-BY-SA-4.0 hardware and docs. GPL-3.0 software. No patents. Ever.

routers: Use Edges and Value the Marginal
